world_seed.visual_direction: Top-down pixel art, cobalt glass, bone-white ceramic, vermilion plumb lines, graphite shadows, brass hardware

genre: civic archive, gravity-rights exchange, spatial bureaucracy
premise: In a city where gravity is a licensed municipal utility, the Archive manages the vectors that keep citizens grounded. Movement is a commodity, and weight is a privilege.
simulation_objective: Manage the flow of gravity licenses while resolving disputes over counterfeit vectors and ballast debt.
economy_focus: Gravity vector licensing and ballast-backed debt instruments.
exploration_focus: Navigating rooms with varying directional pulls and restricted vertical access.
visual_style: Strict top-down pixel art with high-contrast cobalt and vermilion accents on bone-white surfaces.

social_rules: Gravity licenses must be visible at all times (pinned to the chest).
Intentional vector-shifting in public halls is considered assault.
Ballast debt is hereditary; families must carry the weight of their ancestors.
Zero-G zones are restricted to authorized maintenance and medical staff.
All physical weights must be declared upon entry to the Archive.
player_entry_points: Arriving as a new Courier with a heavy debt load.
Entering as a Legal Aide to Arbitrator Kael.
Sneaking in as a Maintenance Contractor to fix a 'leaky' vector.
conflict_hooks: A sudden gravity inversion in the Licensing Wing has scrambled all physical files.
Jax has been caught with a counterfeit vector, and Tessa is coming to repossess his life.
Dr. Elara's report on gravity decay has been stolen, and she suspects Archivist Vane.

gameplay_loops.label: The Licensing Grind
gameplay_loops.summary: Players must navigate the bureaucracy to obtain or renew gravity licenses, using credits or ballast as collateral.
gameplay_loops.pressure: Licenses expire every 24 hours; without one, you float to the ceiling and are arrested.

gameplay_loops.label: The Counterfeit Hunt
gameplay_loops.summary: Players investigate the source of unstable vectors, using lab tools to identify fakes and legal maneuvers to trap smugglers.
gameplay_loops.pressure: Unstable vectors can cause 'Gravity Sickness' or structural damage to the Archive.

visual_canon.world_prompt_prefix: Strict top-down pixel art, Archive of Borrowed Gravity, bone-white and cobalt palette, no text, no signs.
visual_canon.sprite_prompt_prefix: Top-down pixel art character, gravity archive uniform, high contrast.

agent_visual_policy.world_wardrobe_brief: Uniforms are structured and clinical, featuring heavy harnesses for couriers and flowing white robes for clerks. All clothing is accented with vermilion plumb lines.
visual_consistency_rules: All characters must have a visible vermilion cord somewhere on their person.
Harnesses must be rendered with a metallic brass sheen.
Shadows must be cast directly beneath the character to emphasize the top-down view.
